RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: SELECT distinct entityname || '-' || attributelogicalname as TransactionCode, entityname as Attribute2, attributelogicalname as Attribute3, /* case canread when 4 then 'Read' end as Attribute4, case cancreate when 4 then 'Create' end as Attribute5, case canupdate when 4 then 'Update' end as Attribute6,*/ entityname as MainApplicationArea FROM fieldPermissions UNION SELECT businessunitid_name || '__' || name as TransactionCode, '' as Attribute2, '' as Attribute3, /*'' as Attribute4, '' as Attribute5, '' as Attribute6,*/ businessunitid_name as MainApplicationArea from teamtransactions UNION select privileges.name as TransactionCode, '' as Attribute2, '' as Attribute3, /* '' as Attribute4, '' as Attribute5, '' as Attribute6,*/ businessunitid_name as MainApplicationArea from roles inner join roleprivileges on roles.roleid = roleprivileges.roleid inner join privileges on roleprivileges.privilegeid = privileges.privilegeid;
